name: io.github.SerifeusStudio/rpgmaker-xp-mcp
description: Author RPG Maker XP games in natural language: read, write and render RGSS1 .rxdata.

environmentVariables.name: RPGMAKER_PROJECT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the RPG Maker XP project folder — the one containing Game.rxproj and Data/.

environmentVariables.name: RPGMAKER_RTP_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the RPG Maker XP RTP assets. Defaults to the Steam install; set this only if your RTP lives elsewhere.
